Insaan par Allah Ta'ala ke ehsanat ki ek jhalak. Allah Ta'ala apni Rahmat-e-Kamilah ka bayan farmata hai ke usne apne bandon par Quran-e-Karim nazil farmaya aur apne fazl-o-karam se iska hifz karna bilkul aasaan kar diya. Usi ne insaan ko paida kiya aur use bolna sikhaya. Qatadah R.H waghera kehte hain bayan se murad khair-o-sharr hai lekin bolna hi murad lena yahan bahut achha hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur sath hi ta'lim-e-Quran ka zikr hai jis se murad tilawat-e-Quran hai aur tilawat mauqoof hai bolne ki aasani par. Har harf apne makhraj se be-takalluf zaban ada karti rehti hai khwah halq se nikalta ho khwah dono honton ke milane se mukhtalif makhraj aur mukhtalif qisam ke huroof ki adaigi Allah Ta'ala ne insaan ko sikha di. Suraj aur chand ek dusre ke peeche apne apne muqarrara hisab ke mutabiq gardish mein hain, na in mein ikhtilaf ho na iztirab, na yeh aage badhe na woh is par ghalib aaye, har ek apni apni jagah tairta phirta hai aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (FALIQUL ISBAHI WA JA'ALAL LAILA SAKANANW WASHSHAMSA WAL QAMARA HUSBANA, ZALIKA TAQDIRUL AZIZIL ALIM) (Surah Al-An'am: 96), Allah subh ko nikalne wala hai aur usi ne raat ko tumhare liye aaram ka waqt banaya hai aur suraj chand ko hisab par rakha hai, yeh muqarrara mehwar Ghalib-o-Dana Allah ka tay karda hai. Hazrat Ikrimah R.H farmate hain tamam insanon, jinnat, chaupayon, parindon ki aankhon ki basarat ek hi shakhs ki aankhon mein samoo di jaye phir bhi suraj ke samne jo sattar parde hain un mein se ek parda hata diya jaye to namumkin hai ke yeh shakhs phir bhi is ki taraf dekh sake, bawajood-e-ke suraj ka noor Allah ki Kursi ke noor ka sattarwan hissa hai aur Kursi ka noor Arsh ke noor ka sattarwan hissa hai aur Arsh ke noor ke jo parde Allah ke samne hain us ke ek parde ke noor ka sattarwan hissa hai, pas khayal kar lo ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Jannati bandon ki aankhon mein kis qadar noor de rakha hoga ke woh apne Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ke chehre ko khulam khulla apni aankhon se be-rok dekhenge (Ibn Abi Hatim). Is par to mufassirin ka ittefaq hai ke shajar us darakht ko kehte hain jo tane wala ho lekin najm ke ma'ani kayi ek hain, ba'az to kehte hain najm se murad belain hain jin ka tana nahin hota aur zameen par phaili hui hoti hain. Ba'az kehte hain murad is se sitare hain jo aasman mein hain. Yahi qaul zyada zahir hai go awwal qaul Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ka ikhtiyar karda hai, Wallahu A'lam. Quran-e-Karim ki yeh ayat bhi is dusre qaul ki ta'id karti hai. Farman hai ayat (ALAM TARA ANNALLAHA YASJUDU LAHU MAN FIS SAMAWATI WA MAN FIL ARDI WASHSHAMSU WAL QAMARU WAN NUJUMU WAL JIBALU WASH SHAJARU WAD DAWWABBU WA KASIRUM MINAN NASI WA KASIRUN HAQQA ALAIHIL AZABU, WA MAY YUHINILLAHU FAMA LAHU MIM MUKRIM, INNALLAHA YAF'ALU MA YASHA') (Surah Al-Hajj: 18).

(Al-Hajj: 18), Kya tu ne nahin dekha ke Allah ke liye aasman zameen ki tamam makhlooqat aur suraj, chand, sitare, pahar, darakht, chopaye, janwar aur aksar log sajda karte hain. Phir farmata hai aasman ko usi ne buland kiya hai aur usi mein mizan qaim ki hai yani adl jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (LAQAD ARSALNA RUSULANA BIL-BAYYINATI WA ANZALNA MA'AHUMUL-KITABA WAL-MIZANA LIYAQUMAN-NASU BIL-QIST) (57. Al-Hadid: 25) yani yaqeenan hum ne apne rasoolon ko daleelon ke sath aur tarazu ke sath bheja hai taake log adl par qaim ho jayen yahan bhi is ke sath hi farmaya taake tum tarazu mein had se na guzar jao yani us Allah ne aasman-o-zameen ko haq aur adl ke sath paida kiya taake tamam cheezein haq-o-adl ke sath ho jayen, pas farmata hai jab wazan karo to seedhi tarazu se adl-o-haq ke sath wazan karo kami ziyadati na karo ke lete waqt barhti tol liya aur dete waqt kam de diya aur jagah irshad hai aayat (WA ZINU BIL-QISTASIL-MUSTAQIM) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 182) sehat ke sath khare pan se tol kiya karo, aasman ko to us ne buland-o-bala kiya aur zameen ko us ne neechi aur past kar ke bicha diya aur is mein mazboot pahar misl-e-mekh ke gaar diye taake woh hile jule nahin aur is par jo makhlooq basti hai woh ba-aaram rahe phir zameen ki makhlooq ki dekho un ki mukhtalif qismon mukhtalif shaklon mukhtalif rangon mukhtalif zabanon mukhtalif aadat-o-atwar par nazar daal kar Allah ki qudrat-e-kamilah ka andaza karo. Sath hi zameen ki paidawar ko dekho ke rang-barang ke khatte meethe pheeke salone tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale meway phal fruit aur khassatan khajoor ke darakht jo nafa dene wala aur lagne ke waqt se khushk ho jane tak aur is ke baad bhi khane ke kaam mein aane wala aam mewa hai, is par khushey hote hain jinhein cheer kar yeh bahar aata hai phir gudla ho jata hai phir tar ho jata hai phir pak kar theek ho jata hai bohat nafe hai, sath hi is ka darakht bilkul seedha aur be-zarar hota hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Qaisar ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko likha ke mere qasid jo aap ke paas se wapas aaye hain woh kehte hain ke aap ke yahan ek darakht hota hai jis ki si kho-o-khaslat kisi aur mein nahin, woh janwar ke kaan ki tarah zameen se nikalta hai phir khul kar moti ki tarah hojata hai phir sabz ho kar zumurrad ki tarah hojata hai phir surkh ho kar yaqoot jaisa ban jata hai, phir pakta hai aur tayyar ho kar behtareen falooday ke mazay ka hojata hai phir khushk ho kar muqeem logon ke bachao ki aur musafiron ke toshay bhattay ki cheez ban jata hai pas agar mere qasid ki yeh riwayat sahih hai to mere khayal se to yeh darakht Jannati darakht hai. Is ke jawab mein Shah-e-Islam Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne likha ke yeh khat hai Allah ke ghulam musalmanon ke badshah Umar ki taraf se Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke naam. Aap ke qasidon ne jo khabar aap ko di hai woh sach hai, is qisam ke darakht mulk-e-Arab mein bakasrat hain. Yehi woh darakht hai jisay Allah Ta'ala ne Maryam (A.S) ke paas ugaya tha jabke un ke larkay Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) jaisi hai ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne mitti se paida kiya phir farmaya hoja pas woh hogaye. Allah ki taraf se sachi aur haq baat yehi hai tujhe chahiye ke shak-o-shuba karne walon mein na rahe. Akmam ke ma'ani leef ke bhi kiye gaye hain jo darakht khajoor ki gardan par post ki tarah hota hai aur us ne zameen mein bhoosi aur anaaj paida kiya. Asf ke ma'ani kheti ke sabz pattay, matlab yeh hai ke gehoon, jao waghera ke woh daanay jo khosha mein bhoosi samet hote hain aur jo pattay un ke darakhton par liptay hue hote hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kheti se pehle hi ugay hue patton ko to asf kehte hain aur jab daanay nikal aayen, baalein paida hojayen to unhein rehan kehte hain jaise ke Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke mashhoor qaseeday mein hai. Phir farmata hai ae jino aur insano tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ko jhutlao ge? Ya'ni tum us ki ne'amaton mein sar se pair tak doobay hue ho aur mala-maal ho rahe ho, namumkin hai ke haqeeqi taur par tum kisi ne'amat ka inkar kar sako aur usay jhoot bata sako. Ek do ne'amatein hon to khair, yahan to sar-ta-pa us ki ne'amaton se tum dabay hue ho, isi liye momin jinnon ne isay sun kar jhat se jawab diya (Allahumma la bi-shai'in min ala'ika Rabbana nukazzibu falakal hamd). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ke jawab mein farmaya karte thay (La bi-shai'in ya Rabb), ya'ni Khudaya hum in mein se kisi ne'amat ka inkar nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki sahibzadi Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain ke shuru shuru risalat ke zamana mein abhi Amr-e-Islam ka poori tarah elaan na hua tha, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Baitullah mein dukan ki taraf namaz parhte hue dekha, aap is namaz mein is Surah ki tilawat farma rahe thay aur mushrikeen bhi sun rahe thay.

Is par to mufassirin ka ittefaq hai ke shajar us darakht ko kehte hain jo tane wala ho lekin najm ke ma'ani kayi ek hain, ba'az to kehte hain najm se murad belain hain jin ka tana nahin hota aur zameen par phaili hui hoti hain. Ba'az kehte hain murad is se sitare hain jo aasman mein hain. Yahi qaul zyada zahir hai go awwal qaul Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ka ikhtiyar karda hai, Wallahu A'lam. Al-Hadid: 25) yani yaqeenan hum ne apne rasoolon ko daleelon ke sath aur tarazu ke sath bheja hai taake log adl par qaim ho jayen yahan bhi is ke sath hi farmaya taake tum tarazu mein had se na guzar jao yani us Allah ne aasman-o-zameen ko haq aur adl ke sath paida kiya taake tamam cheezein haq-o-adl ke sath ho jayen, pas farmata hai jab wazan karo to seedhi tarazu se adl-o-haq ke sath wazan karo kami ziyadati na karo ke lete waqt barhti tol liya aur dete waqt kam de diya aur jagah irshad hai aayat (WA ZINU BIL-QISTASIL-MUSTAQIM) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 182) sehat ke sath khare pan se tol kiya karo, aasman ko to us ne buland-o-bala kiya aur zameen ko us ne neechi aur past kar ke bicha diya aur is mein mazboot pahar misl-e-mekh ke gaar diye taake woh hile jule nahin aur is par jo makhlooq basti hai woh ba-aaram rahe phir zameen ki makhlooq ki dekho un ki mukhtalif qismon mukhtalif shaklon mukhtalif rangon mukhtalif zabanon mukhtalif aadat-o-atwar par nazar daal kar Allah ki qudrat-e-kamilah ka andaza karo. Sath hi zameen ki paidawar ko dekho ke rang-barang ke khatte meethe pheeke salone tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale meway phal fruit aur khassatan khajoor ke darakht jo nafa dene wala aur lagne ke waqt se khushk ho jane tak aur is ke baad bhi khane ke kaam mein aane wala aam mewa hai, is par khushey hote hain jinhein cheer kar yeh bahar aata hai phir gudla ho jata hai phir tar ho jata hai phir pak kar theek ho jata hai bohat nafe hai, sath hi is ka darakht bilkul seedha aur be-zarar hota hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Qaisar ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko likha ke mere qasid jo aap ke paas se wapas aaye hain woh kehte hain ke aap ke yahan ek darakht hota hai jis ki si kho-o-khaslat kisi aur mein nahin, woh janwar ke kaan ki tarah zameen se nikalta hai phir khul kar moti ki tarah hojata hai phir sabz ho kar zumurrad ki tarah hojata hai phir surkh ho kar yaqoot jaisa ban jata hai, phir pakta hai aur tayyar ho kar behtareen falooday ke mazay ka hojata hai phir khushk ho kar muqeem logon ke bachao ki aur musafiron ke toshay bhattay ki cheez ban jata hai pas agar mere qasid ki yeh riwayat sahih hai to mere khayal se to yeh darakht Jannati darakht hai. Is ke jawab mein Shah-e-Islam Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne likha ke yeh khat hai Allah ke ghulam musalmanon ke badshah Umar ki taraf se Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke naam. Aap ke qasidon ne jo khabar aap ko di hai woh sach hai, is qisam ke darakht mulk-e-Arab mein bakasrat hain. Yehi woh darakht hai jisay Allah Ta'ala ne Maryam (A.S) ke paas ugaya tha jabke un ke larkay Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) jaisi hai ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne mitti se paida kiya phir farmaya hoja pas woh hogaye. Allah ki taraf se sachi aur haq baat yehi hai tujhe chahiye ke shak-o-shuba karne walon mein na rahe. Akmam ke ma'ani leef ke bhi kiye gaye hain jo darakht khajoor ki gardan par post ki tarah hota hai aur us ne zameen mein bhoosi aur anaaj paida kiya. Asf ke ma'ani kheti ke sabz pattay, matlab yeh hai ke gehoon, jao waghera ke woh daanay jo khosha mein bhoosi samet hote hain aur jo pattay un ke darakhton par liptay hue hote hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kheti se pehle hi ugay hue patton ko to asf kehte hain aur jab daanay nikal aayen, baalein paida hojayen to unhein rehan kehte hain jaise ke Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke mashhoor qaseeday mein hai. Phir farmata hai ae jino aur insano tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ko jhutlao ge? Ya'ni tum us ki ne'amaton mein sar se pair tak doobay hue ho aur mala-maal ho rahe ho, namumkin hai ke haqeeqi taur par tum kisi ne'amat ka inkar kar sako aur usay jhoot bata sako. Ek do ne'amatein hon to khair, yahan to sar-ta-pa us ki ne'amaton se tum dabay hue ho, isi liye momin jinnon ne isay sun kar jhat se jawab diya (Allahumma la bi-shai'in min ala'ika Rabbana nukazzibu falakal hamd). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ke jawab mein farmaya karte thay (La bi-shai'in ya Rabb), ya'ni Khudaya hum in mein se kisi ne'amat ka inkar nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki sahibzadi Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain ke shuru shuru risalat ke zamana mein abhi Amr-e-Islam ka poori tarah elaan na hua tha, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Baitullah mein dukan ki taraf namaz parhte hue dekha, aap is namaz mein is Surah ki tilawat farma rahe thay aur mushrikeen bhi sun rahe thay.

Is par to mufassirin ka ittefaq hai ke shajar us darakht ko kehte hain jo tane wala ho lekin najm ke ma'ani kayi ek hain, ba'az to kehte hain najm se murad belain hain jin ka tana nahin hota aur zameen par phaili hui hoti hain. Ba'az kehte hain murad is se sitare hain jo aasman mein hain. Yahi qaul zyada zahir hai go awwal qaul Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ka ikhtiyar karda hai, Wallahu A'lam. Al-Hadid: 25) yani yaqeenan hum ne apne rasoolon ko daleelon ke sath aur tarazu ke sath bheja hai taake log adl par qaim ho jayen yahan bhi is ke sath hi farmaya taake tum tarazu mein had se na guzar jao yani us Allah ne aasman-o-zameen ko haq aur adl ke sath paida kiya taake tamam cheezein haq-o-adl ke sath ho jayen, pas farmata hai jab wazan karo to seedhi tarazu se adl-o-haq ke sath wazan karo kami ziyadati na karo ke lete waqt barhti tol liya aur dete waqt kam de diya aur jagah irshad hai aayat (WA ZINU BIL-QISTASIL-MUSTAQIM) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 182) sehat ke sath khare pan se tol kiya karo, aasman ko to us ne buland-o-bala kiya aur zameen ko us ne neechi aur past kar ke bicha diya aur is mein mazboot pahar misl-e-mekh ke gaar diye taake woh hile jule nahin aur is par jo makhlooq basti hai woh ba-aaram rahe phir zameen ki makhlooq ki dekho un ki mukhtalif qismon mukhtalif shaklon mukhtalif rangon mukhtalif zabanon mukhtalif aadat-o-atwar par nazar daal kar Allah ki qudrat-e-kamilah ka andaza karo. Sath hi zameen ki paidawar ko dekho ke rang-barang ke khatte meethe pheeke salone tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale meway phal fruit aur khassatan khajoor ke darakht jo nafa dene wala aur lagne ke waqt se khushk ho jane tak aur is ke baad bhi khane ke kaam mein aane wala aam mewa hai, is par khushey hote hain jinhein cheer kar yeh bahar aata hai phir gudla ho jata hai phir tar ho jata hai phir pak kar theek ho jata hai bohat nafe hai, sath hi is ka darakht bilkul seedha aur be-zarar hota hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Qaisar ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko likha ke mere qasid jo aap ke paas se wapas aaye hain woh kehte hain ke aap ke yahan ek darakht hota hai jis ki si kho-o-khaslat kisi aur mein nahin, woh janwar ke kaan ki tarah zameen se nikalta hai phir khul kar moti ki tarah hojata hai phir sabz ho kar zumurrad ki tarah hojata hai phir surkh ho kar yaqoot jaisa ban jata hai, phir pakta hai aur tayyar ho kar behtareen falooday ke mazay ka hojata hai phir khushk ho kar muqeem logon ke bachao ki aur musafiron ke toshay bhattay ki cheez ban jata hai pas agar mere qasid ki yeh riwayat sahih hai to mere khayal se to yeh darakht Jannati darakht hai. Is ke jawab mein Shah-e-Islam Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne likha ke yeh khat hai Allah ke ghulam musalmanon ke badshah Umar ki taraf se Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke naam. Aap ke qasidon ne jo khabar aap ko di hai woh sach hai, is qisam ke darakht mulk-e-Arab mein bakasrat hain. Yehi woh darakht hai jisay Allah Ta'ala ne Maryam (A.S) ke paas ugaya tha jabke un ke larkay Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) jaisi hai ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne mitti se paida kiya phir farmaya hoja pas woh hogaye. Allah ki taraf se sachi aur haq baat yehi hai tujhe chahiye ke shak-o-shuba karne walon mein na rahe. Akmam ke ma'ani leef ke bhi kiye gaye hain jo darakht khajoor ki gardan par post ki tarah hota hai aur us ne zameen mein bhoosi aur anaaj paida kiya. Asf ke ma'ani kheti ke sabz pattay, matlab yeh hai ke gehoon, jao waghera ke woh daanay jo khosha mein bhoosi samet hote hain aur jo pattay un ke darakhton par liptay hue hote hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kheti se pehle hi ugay hue patton ko to asf kehte hain aur jab daanay nikal aayen, baalein paida hojayen to unhein rehan kehte hain jaise ke Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke mashhoor qaseeday mein hai. Phir farmata hai ae jino aur insano tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ko jhutlao ge? Ya'ni tum us ki ne'amaton mein sar se pair tak doobay hue ho aur mala-maal ho rahe ho, namumkin hai ke haqeeqi taur par tum kisi ne'amat ka inkar kar sako aur usay jhoot bata sako. Ek do ne'amatein hon to khair, yahan to sar-ta-pa us ki ne'amaton se tum dabay hue ho, isi liye momin jinnon ne isay sun kar jhat se jawab diya (Allahumma la bi-shai'in min ala'ika Rabbana nukazzibu falakal hamd). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ke jawab mein farmaya karte thay (La bi-shai'in ya Rabb), ya'ni Khudaya hum in mein se kisi ne'amat ka inkar nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki sahibzadi Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain ke shuru shuru risalat ke zamana mein abhi Amr-e-Islam ka poori tarah elaan na hua tha, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Baitullah mein dukan ki taraf namaz parhte hue dekha, aap is namaz mein is Surah ki tilawat farma rahe thay aur mushrikeen bhi sun rahe thay.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Qaisar ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko likha ke mere qasid jo aap ke paas se wapas aaye hain woh kehte hain ke aap ke yahan ek darakht hota hai jis ki si kho-o-khaslat kisi aur mein nahin, woh janwar ke kaan ki tarah zameen se nikalta hai phir khul kar moti ki tarah hojata hai phir sabz ho kar zumurrad ki tarah hojata hai phir surkh ho kar yaqoot jaisa ban jata hai, phir pakta hai aur tayyar ho kar behtareen falooday ke mazay ka hojata hai phir khushk ho kar muqeem logon ke bachao ki aur musafiron ke toshay bhattay ki cheez ban jata hai pas agar mere qasid ki yeh riwayat sahih hai to mere khayal se to yeh darakht Jannati darakht hai. Is ke jawab mein Shah-e-Islam Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne likha ke yeh khat hai Allah ke ghulam musalmanon ke badshah Umar ki taraf se Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke naam. Aap ke qasidon ne jo khabar aap ko di hai woh sach hai, is qisam ke darakht mulk-e-Arab mein bakasrat hain. Yehi woh darakht hai jisay Allah Ta'ala ne Maryam (A.S) ke paas ugaya tha jabke un ke larkay Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) jaisi hai ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne mitti se paida kiya phir farmaya hoja pas woh hogaye. Allah ki taraf se sachi aur haq baat yehi hai tujhe chahiye ke shak-o-shuba karne walon mein na rahe. Akmam ke ma'ani leef ke bhi kiye gaye hain jo darakht khajoor ki gardan par post ki tarah hota hai aur us ne zameen mein bhoosi aur anaaj paida kiya. Asf ke ma'ani kheti ke sabz pattay, matlab yeh hai ke gehoon, jao waghera ke woh daanay jo khosha mein bhoosi samet hote hain aur jo pattay un ke darakhton par liptay hue hote hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kheti se pehle hi ugay hue patton ko to asf kehte hain aur jab daanay nikal aayen, baalein paida hojayen to unhein rehan kehte hain jaise ke Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke mashhoor qaseeday mein hai. Phir farmata hai ae jino aur insano tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ko jhutlao ge? Ya'ni tum us ki ne'amaton mein sar se pair tak doobay hue ho aur mala-maal ho rahe ho, namumkin hai ke haqeeqi taur par tum kisi ne'amat ka inkar kar sako aur usay jhoot bata sako. Ek do ne'amatein hon to khair, yahan to sar-ta-pa us ki ne'amaton se tum dabay hue ho, isi liye momin jinnon ne isay sun kar jhat se jawab diya (Allahumma la bi-shai'in min ala'ika Rabbana nukazzibu falakal hamd). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ke jawab mein farmaya karte thay (La bi-shai'in ya Rabb), ya'ni Khudaya hum in mein se kisi ne'amat ka inkar nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki sahibzadi Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain ke shuru shuru risalat ke zamana mein abhi Amr-e-Islam ka poori tarah elaan na hua tha, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Baitullah mein dukan ki taraf namaz parhte hue dekha, aap is namaz mein is Surah ki tilawat farma rahe thay aur mushrikeen bhi sun rahe thay.

Insaan aur jinnat ki paidaish mein farq yahan bayan ho raha hai ke insaan ki paidaish bajne wali thikri jaisi mitti se hui hai aur jinnat ki paidaish aag ke sholay se hui hai jo khalis aur ahsan tha. Musnad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain farishtay noor se, jinnat naar se aur insaan us mitti se jis ka zikr tumhare samne ho chuka hai paida kiye gaye hain. Phir apni kisi nemat ke jhutlane ki hidayat kar ke farmata hai jaaray aur garmi ke do suraj ke nikalne aur doobne ke maqamat ka Rab Allah hi hai. Do se murad suraj nikalne aur doobne ki do mukhtalif jaghein hain ke wahan se suraj charhta utarta hai aur mausam ke lihaz se yeh badalti jaghein rehti hain, har din inqilab lata hai. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai, Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rab wahi hai to usi ko apna wakeel samajh, to yahan murad jins-e-Mashriq-o-Maghrib hai aur dusri Mashriq-o-Maghrib se murad tulu-o-ghuroob ki do jaghein hain. Aur chunke tulu-o-ghuroob ki jagah ke juda juda hone mein insani manfa'at aur us ki maslahat-e-beeni thi is liye phir farmaya ke kya ab bhi tum apne Rab ki nematon ke munkir hi raho ge? Us ki qudrat ka muzahira dekho ke do samundar barabar chal rahe hain, ek khari pani ka hai dusra meethe pani ka, lekin na us ka pani is mein mil kar use khari karta hai na us ka meetha pani is mein mil kar use meetha kar sakta hai, balkay dono apni raftar se chal rahe hain. Dono ke darmiyan ek parda hail hai, na woh is mein mil sake na woh is mein ja sake, yeh apni had mein hai woh apni had mein aur qudrati fasla unhein alag alag kiye hue hai halankeh dono pani mile hue hain. Surah Furqan ki aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ ھٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّھٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌ ۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَّحِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا) (25. Al-Furqan: 53), ki tafsir mein is ki poori tashreeh guzar chuki hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yeh bhi farmate hain ke aasman mein jo pani ka qatra hai aur sadaf jo zameen ke darya mein hai un dono se mil kar lu'lu paida hota hai. Waqia to yeh theek hai lekin is aayat ki tafsir is tarah karni kuch munasib maloom nahin hoti is liye ke aayat mein un dono ke darmiyan barzakh yani aar ka hona bayan farmaya gaya hai jo is ko is se aur is ko is se roke hue hain. Is se maloom hota hai ke yeh dono zameen mein hi hain balkay ek dusre se lage lage chalte hain magar qudrat unhein juda rakhti hai. Aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan jo fasla hai woh barzakh aur hijr nahin kaha jata, is liye sahih qaul yahi hai ke yeh zameen ke do daryaon ka zikr hai na ke aasman aur zameen ke darya ka. In dono mein se yani dono mein se ek mein se.

Jaise aur jagah Jinn-o-Ins ko khitab kar ke sawal hua hai ke kya tumhare paas tumhein mein se Rasool nahin aaye thay? Zahir hai ke Rasool sirf insaan mein se hi huye hain, Jinnat mein koi Jinn Rasool nahin aaya, toh jaise yahan itla' sahi hai halankeh waqoo' ek mein hi hai, isi tarah is aayat mein bhi itlaq dono darya par hai aur waqoo' ek mein hi hai. Lu'lu' ya'ni moti ko kehte hain, aur kaha gaya hai ke behtareen aur umda moti ko Marjan kehte hain. Ba'z kehte hain surkh rang jawaahir ko kehte hain, ba'z kehte hain surkh mohre ka naam hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Wamin kullin ta'kuluna lahman tariyyan watastakhrijuna hilyatan talbasunaha, wataral fulka fihi mawakhiba litabtaghu min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkurun) (Surah Fatir: 12), ya'ni tum har ek mein se nikla hua gosht khate ho jo taaza hota hai aur pehanne ke zevar nikalte ho. Toh khair machli toh khari aur meethe dono paani se nikalti hai aur moti, moongay sirf khari paani mein se nikalte hain, meethe mein se nahin nikalte. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke aasman ka jo qatra samundar ki seep ke munh mein seedha jata hai woh lu'lu' ban jata hai aur jab sadaf mein nahin jata toh us se ambar paida hota hai, meenh baraste waqt seep apna munh khol deti hai. Pas is ne'mat ko bayan farma kar phir daryaft farmata hai ke aisi hi beshumar ne'matein jis Rabb ki hain tum bhala kis kis ne'mat ki takzeeb karoge? Phir irshad hota hai ke samundar mein chalne wale bade bade baadbanon wale jahaz jo door se nazar padte hain aur pahadon ki tarah khade dikhayi dete hain, jo hazaron man maal aur saikdon insaanon ko idhar se udhar le aate hain, yeh bhi toh us Allah ki malkiyat mein hain. Is aalishan ne'mat ko yaad dila kar phir poochta hai ke ab batao inkar kiye kaise ban aayegi? Hazrat Umair bin Suwaid (R.A) farmate hain main Allah ke sher Hazrat Ali Murtaza (R.A) ke sath darya-e-Furat ke kinare par tha, ek buland-o-bala bada jahaz aa raha tha, use dekh kar aap ne us ki taraf apne hath se ishara kar ke is aayat ki tilawat ki, phir farmaya: Us Allah ki qasam jis ne pahadon jaisi in kashtiyon ko amwaj-e-samundar mein jaari kiya hai, na main ne Usman-e-Ghani (R.A) ko qatl kiya, na un ke qatl ka irada kiya, na qatilon ke sath shareek hua, na un se khush, na un par narm.

In dono mein se yani dono mein se ek mein se.

Toh khair machli toh khari aur meethe dono paani se nikalti hai aur moti, moongay sirf khari paani mein se nikalte hain, meethe mein se nahin nikalte. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke aasman ka jo qatra samundar ki seep ke munh mein seedha jata hai woh lu'lu' ban jata hai aur jab sadaf mein nahin jata toh us se ambar paida hota hai, meenh baraste waqt seep apna munh khol deti hai. Pas is ne'mat ko bayan farma kar phir daryaft farmata hai ke aisi hi beshumar ne'matein jis Rabb ki hain tum bhala kis kis ne'mat ki takzeeb karoge? Phir irshad hota hai ke samundar mein chalne wale bade bade baadbanon wale jahaz jo door se nazar padte hain aur pahadon ki tarah khade dikhayi dete hain, jo hazaron man maal aur saikdon insaanon ko idhar se udhar le aate hain, yeh bhi toh us Allah ki malkiyat mein hain. Is aalishan ne'mat ko yaad dila kar phir poochta hai ke ab batao inkar kiye kaise ban aayegi? Hazrat Umair bin Suwaid (R.A) farmate hain main Allah ke sher Hazrat Ali Murtaza (R.A) ke sath darya-e-Furat ke kinare par tha, ek buland-o-bala bada jahaz aa raha tha, use dekh kar aap ne us ki taraf apne hath se ishara kar ke is aayat ki tilawat ki, phir farmaya: Us Allah ki qasam jis ne pahadon jaisi in kashtiyon ko amwaj-e-samundar mein jaari kiya hai, na main ne Usman-e-Ghani (R.A) ko qatl kiya, na un ke qatl ka irada kiya, na qatilon ke sath shareek hua, na un se khush, na un par narm.

Insaan aur jinnat ki paidaish mein farq yahan bayan ho raha hai ke insaan ki paidaish bajne wali thikri jaisi mitti se hui hai aur jinnat ki paidaish aag ke sholay se hui hai jo khalis aur ahsan tha. Musnad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain farishtay noor se, jinnat naar se aur insaan us mitti se jis ka zikr tumhare samne ho chuka hai paida kiye gaye hain. Phir apni kisi nemat ke jhutlane ki hidayat kar ke farmata hai jaaray aur garmi ke do suraj ke nikalne aur doobne ke maqamat ka Rab Allah hi hai. Do se murad suraj nikalne aur doobne ki do mukhtalif jaghein hain ke wahan se suraj charhta utarta hai aur mausam ke lihaz se yeh badalti jaghein rehti hain, har din inqilab lata hai. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai, Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rab wahi hai to usi ko apna wakeel samajh, to yahan murad jins-e-Mashriq-o-Maghrib hai aur dusri Mashriq-o-Maghrib se murad tulu-o-ghuroob ki do jaghein hain. Aur chunke tulu-o-ghuroob ki jagah ke juda juda hone mein insani manfa'at aur us ki maslahat-e-beeni thi is liye phir farmaya ke kya ab bhi tum apne Rab ki nematon ke munkir hi raho ge? Us ki qudrat ka muzahira dekho ke do samundar barabar chal rahe hain, ek khari pani ka hai dusra meethe pani ka, lekin na us ka pani is mein mil kar use khari karta hai na us ka meetha pani is mein mil kar use meetha kar sakta hai, balkay dono apni raftar se chal rahe hain. Dono ke darmiyan ek parda hail hai, na woh is mein mil sake na woh is mein ja sake, yeh apni had mein hai woh apni had mein aur qudrati fasla unhein alag alag kiye hue hai halankeh dono pani mile hue hain. Surah Furqan ki aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ ھٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّھٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌ ۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَّحِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا) (25. Al-Furqan: 53), ki tafsir mein is ki poori tashreeh guzar chuki hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yeh bhi farmate hain ke aasman mein jo pani ka qatra hai aur sadaf jo zameen ke darya mein hai un dono se mil kar lu'lu paida hota hai. Waqia to yeh theek hai lekin is aayat ki tafsir is tarah karni kuch munasib maloom nahin hoti is liye ke aayat mein un dono ke darmiyan barzakh yani aar ka hona bayan farmaya gaya hai jo is ko is se aur is ko is se roke hue hain. Is se maloom hota hai ke yeh dono zameen mein hi hain balkay ek dusre se lage lage chalte hain magar qudrat unhein juda rakhti hai. Aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan jo fasla hai woh barzakh aur hijr nahin kaha jata, is liye sahih qaul yahi hai ke yeh zameen ke do daryaon ka zikr hai na ke aasman aur zameen ke darya ka. In dono mein se yani dono mein se ek mein se.

Jaise aur jagah Jinn-o-Ins ko khitab kar ke sawal hua hai ke kya tumhare paas tumhein mein se Rasool nahin aaye thay? Zahir hai ke Rasool sirf insaan mein se hi huye hain, Jinnat mein koi Jinn Rasool nahin aaya, toh jaise yahan itla' sahi hai halankeh waqoo' ek mein hi hai, isi tarah is aayat mein bhi itlaq dono darya par hai aur waqoo' ek mein hi hai. Allah Ta'ala ke siwa baqi sab fana. Farmata hai ke zameen ki kul makhlooq fana hone wali hai, ek din aayega ke is par kuch na hoga, kul jaandar makhlooq ko maut aa jayegi, isi tarah kul aasman wale bhi maut ka maza chakhenge magar jise Allah chahe, sirf Allah ki zaat baqi reh jayegi jo hamesha se hai aur hamesha tak hai, jo maut-o-faut se pak hai. Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain, awwalan to paidaish-e-aalam ka zikr farmaya, phir unki fana ka bayan kiya. Huzoor ﷺ se ek manqool dua mein yeh bhi hai: (Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu Ya Badi'us-Samawati wal-Ardi Ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram, La ilaha illa anta, birahmatika nastagheesu, aslih lana sha'nana kullahu, wala takilna ila anfusina tarfata 'ainin wala ila ahadin min khalqika). Ya'ni ae hamesha jeene aur abdal-aabad tak baqi aur tamam qaim rehne wale Allah! Ae aasman-o-zameen ke ibtida paida karne wale! Ae Rabb-e-Jalal aur buzurgi wale parwardigar! Tere siwa koi mabood nahin, hum teri rahmat hi se istighasa karte hain, hamare tamam kaam tu bana de aur aankh jhapakne ke barabar bhi tu hamari taraf na sonp aur na apni makhlooq mein se kisi ki taraf. Hazrat Sha'bi R.H farmate hain, jab tu aayat (Kullu man 'alaiha fan) padhe to thehar nahin aur sath hi aayat (Wa yabqa wajhu Rabbika Zul-Jalali wal-Ikram) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 27) padh le. Is aayat ka mazmoon dusri aayat mein in alfaaz se hai: Aayat (Kullu shai'in halikun illa wajhahu, lahul-hukmu wa ilaihi turja'oon) (Surah Al-Qasas: 88). Siwaye Zaat-e-Bari ke har cheez na-paid hone wali hai. Phir apne chehre ki tareef mein farmata hai, woh Zul-Jalal hai, ya'ni is qabil hai ke uski izzat ki jaye, uska jaah-o-jalal mana jaye aur uske ahkaam ki ita'at ki jaye aur uske farman ki khilaf-warzi se ruka jaye. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wasbir nafsaka ma'allazina yad'oona Rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-'ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu wala ta'du 'ainaka 'anhum) (Surah Al-Kahf: 28), jo log subh-o-sham apne parwardigar ko pukarte rehte hain aur usi ki zaat ke mureed hain to unhi ke sath apne nafs ko wabasta rakh. Aur aayat mein irshad hota hai ke nek log sadqa dete waqt samajhte hain ke hum mahz Allah ki raza ke liye khilate pilate hain. Woh kibriyai, badai, azmat aur jalal wala hai. Pas is baat ko bayan farma kar ke tamam ahl-e-zameen faut hone mein aur phir Allah ke samne Qayamat ke din pesh hone mein barabar hain aur us din woh buzurgi wala Allah unke darmiyan adl-o-insaf ke sath hukm farmayega, sath hi farmaya ab tum ae Jinn-o-Ins Rabb ki kaunsi ne'mat ka inkar karte ho? Phir farmata hai ke woh sari makhlooq se be-niyaz hai aur kul makhlooq uski yaksar mohtaj hai, sab ke sab sail hain, woh Ghani hai, sab faqeer hain aur woh sab ke sawal pure karne wala hai. Har makhlooq apne haal-o-qaal se apni hajatein uski bargah mein le jati hai aur unke pura hone ka sawal karti hai. Woh har din nayi shaan mein hai, uski shaan hai ke har pukarne wale ko jawab de.

Maangne wale ko ata farmaye, tang haalon ko kushadgi de, museebat-o-aafaat walon ko rihayi bakhshe, beemaron ko tandurusti inayat farmaye, gham-o-ham door kare, beqarar ki beqarari ke waqt ki dua ko qabool farma kar use qarar aur aaram inayat farmaye. Gunahgaron ke wawela par mutawajja ho kar khataon se darguzar farmaye, gunahon ko bakhshe, zindagi woh de, maut woh de, tamam zameen wale, kul aasman wale us ke aage haath phailaye hue aur daaman phailaye hue hain. Chhoton ko bada woh karta hai, qaidiyon ko rihayi woh deta hai, nek logon ki hajaton ko poora karne wala, un ki pukar ka mudda, un ke shikwe shikayat ka marja wahi hai. Ghulamon ko azaad karne ki raghbat wahi dilane wala aur un ko apni taraf se atiya wahi ata farmata hai, yahi us ki shaan hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki to sahaba ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh shaan kya hai? Farmaya gunahon ka bakhshna, dukh ko door karna, logon ko taraqqi aur tanazzuli par lana. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein aur Ibn-e-Asakir mein bhi isi ke hum-ma'ni ek hadees hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh riwayat mu'allaqan Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) ke qaul se marwi hai, Bazzar mein bhi kuch kami ke sath marfu'an marwi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Lauh-e-Mehfooz ko safed moti se paida kiya, us ke dono takhte surkh yaqoot ke hain, us ka qalam noori hai, us ki chaudai aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai. Har roz teen sau saath martaba use dekhta hai, har nigah par kisi ko zindagi deta aur marta aur izzat-o-zillat deta hai aur jo chahe karta hai.

Farmata hai ke zameen ki kul makhlooq fana hone wali hai, ek din aayega ke is par kuch na hoga, kul jaandar makhlooq ko maut aa jayegi, isi tarah kul aasman wale bhi maut ka maza chakhenge magar jise Allah chahe, sirf Allah ki zaat baqi reh jayegi jo hamesha se hai aur hamesha tak hai, jo maut-o-faut se pak hai. Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain, awwalan to paidaish-e-aalam ka zikr farmaya, phir unki fana ka bayan kiya. Huzoor ﷺ se ek manqool dua mein yeh bhi hai: (Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu Ya Badi'us-Samawati wal-Ardi Ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram, La ilaha illa anta, birahmatika nastagheesu, aslih lana sha'nana kullahu, wala takilna ila anfusina tarfata 'ainin wala ila ahadin min khalqika). Siwaye Zaat-e-Bari ke har cheez na-paid hone wali hai. Aasman phat jaye ga waqt-e-ehtisab hoga. Aasman ka phat jana aur aayaton mein bhi bayan hua hai. Irshad hai aayat (WA-INSHAQQATIS-SAMA'U FAHIYA YAWM'IDHIN WAHIYAH) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 16). Ek aur jagah hai aayat (WA YAWMA TASH AQQQUS-SAMA'U BIL-GHAMAMI WA NUNZILAL-MALA'IKATU TANZILA) (Surah Al-Furqan: 25), aur farman hai aayat (IDHAS-SAMA'UN SHAQQAT) (Surah Al-Inshiqaq: 1), waghera. Jis tarah chandi waghera pighlai jati hai yahi halat aasman ki ho jaye gi, rang par rang badle ga kyunke Qayamat ki holnaki, uski shiddat-o-dehshat hai hi aisi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai log Qayamat ke din uthaye jayenge aur aasman un par halki barish ki tarah barasta hoga. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain surkh chamre ki tarah ho jaye ga. Ek riwayat mein gulabi rang, ghore ke rang jaisa aasman ka rang ho jaye ga. Abu Saleh R.H farmate hain pehle gulabi rang hoga phir surkh ho jaye ga. Gulabi rang ghore ka rang mausam-e-bahar mein toh zardi mail nazar aata hai aur jare mein badal kar surkh jachta hai, joon joon sardi barhti hai uska rang mutaghayyar hota jata hai. Isi tarah aasman bhi rang par rang badle ga, pighle hue tanbe ki tarah ho jaye ga. Jaise roghan-e-gulab ka rang hota hai us rang ka aasman ho jaye ga. Aaj woh sabz rang hai lekin us din uska rang surkhi liye hue hoga, zaitoon ki talchhat jaisa ho jaye ga. Jahannam ki aag tapish use pighla kar tel jaisa kar degi. Us din kisi mujrim se uska jurm na pucha jaye ga jaise ek aur aayat mein hai (HADHA YAWMU LA YANTIQUN) (Surah Al-Mursalat: 35), yeh woh din hai ke baat na karenge na unhein ijazat di jaye gi ke woh uzr-o-ma'zarat karein. Haan aur aayaton mein unka bolna, uzr karna, un se hisab liya jana waghera bhi bayan hua hai. Farman hai aayat (FAWARABBIKA LANAS'ALANNAHUM AJMA'IN) (Surah Al-Hijr: 92), tere Rab ki qasam hum sab se sawal karenge aur un ke tamam kamon ki pursish karenge. Toh matlab yeh hai ke ek mauqa par yeh hai pursish hui, hisab kitab hua, uzr-o-ma'zarat khatam kar di gayi, ab munh par mohar lag gayi, hath paon aur a'za-e-jism ne gawahi di, phir puch guch ki zaroorat na rahi, uzr-o-ma'zarat tor di gayi. Aur yeh tatbiq bhi hai ke kisi se na pucha jaye ga ke falan amal kiya? Ya nahin kiya? Kyunke Allah ko toh khub maloom hai, us se jo sawal hoga woh yeh ke aisa kyun kiya? Teesra qaul yeh hai ke farishte puchenge nahin, woh toh chehra dekhte hi pehchan lenge aur jahannami ko zanjeeron mein bandh kar ondhay ghasit kar jahannam wasil kar denge, jaise is ke baad hi farmaya ke yeh gunahgar apne chehron aur apni khas alamaton se pehchan liye jayenge, chehre siyah honge, aankhein kairi hongi, theek isi tarah mominon ke chehre bhi alag mumtaz honge. Un ke a'za-e-wuzu chand ki tarah chamak rahe honge.

Gunahgaron ko peshaniyon aur qadmon se pakra jaye ga aur Jahannam mein daal diya jaye ga jis tarah bari lakri ko do taraf se pakar kar tanoor mein jhonk diya jata hai. Peeth ki taraf zanjeer la kar gardan aur paon ek kar ke bandh diye jayenge. Kamar tor di jaye gi aur qadam aur peshani mila di jaye gi aur jakar diya jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai qabeela Banu Kunda ka ek shakhs Mai Aisha (R.A) ke paas gaya. Parde ke peeche baitha aur Umm-ul-Momineen se sawal kiya ke kya aap ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh bhi suna hai ke kisi waqt aap (ﷺ) ko kisi shakhs ki shafa'at ka ikhtiyar na hoga? Umm-ul-Momineen ne jawab diya haan, ek martaba ek hi kapre mein hum dono thay, main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ) se yahi sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya haan, jab ke Pul-e-Sirat rakha jaye ga us waqt mujhe kisi ki shafa'at ka ikhtiyar na hoga yahan tak ke main jaan loon ke khud mujhe kahan le jate hain? Aur jis waqt ke chehre safaid hone shuru honge yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mere sath kya kya kiya jata hai? Ya farmaya yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mujh par kya wahi bheji jati hai? Aur jab Jahannam par pul rakha jaye ga aur use tez aur garam kiya jaye ga, main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is ki tezi aur garmi ki kya had hai? Farmaya talwar ki dhaar jaisa tez hoga aur aag ke angare jaisa garam hoga. Momin to be-zarar guzar jaye ga aur munafiq latak jaye ga, jab beech mein pohanche ga us ke qadam phisal jayenge, yeh apne hath apne pairon ki taraf jhukaye ga jis tarah koi nange paon chal raha ho aur use kanta lag jaye aur us zor ka lage ke goya ke us ne us ka paon chhed diya to kis tarah be-sabri aur jaldi se woh sar aur hath jhuka kar us ki taraf jhuk parta hai, isi tarah yeh jhuke ga, udhar yeh jhuka udhar darogha-e-Jahannam ki aag mein gira de ga jis mein taqreeban pachaas pachaas saal tak woh gehra utarta jaye ga. Main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh jahannami kis qadar bojhal hoga? Aap ne farmaya misl das gabhan oontniyon ke wazan ke, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is ke ba'az fiqron ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ke kalam se hona munkar hai aur is ki asnaad mein ek shakhs hai jis ka naam bhi neeche rawi ne nahin liya. Is jaisi daleelein sehat ke qabil nahin hotin, Wallahu A'alam. In gunahgaron se kaha jaye ga ke lo jis Jahannam ka tum inkar karte thay use apni aankhon se dekh lo, yeh unhein bator-e-ruswa aur zaleel karne, sharminda aur nadim karne, un ki khiffat barhane ke liye kaha jaye ga. Phir un ki yeh halat hogi ke kabhi aag ka azab ho raha hai kabhi pani ka. Kabhi Jaheem mein jalaye jate hain aur kabhi Hameem pilaye jate hain. Jo pighle hue tanbe ki tarah mehez aag hai jo aanton ko kaat deti hai aur jagah hai aayat (Izi-l-aghlalu fi a'naqihim wa-ssalasilu yushabun) (40. Ghafir: 71), jab ke un ki gardanon mein toq honge aur paon mein beriyan hongi, woh Hameem se Jaheem mein ghaseete jayenge aur baar baar yeh jalaye jayenge.

Yeh garam pani hadd-e-darja ka garam hoga, bas yun kehna theek hai ke woh bhi Jahannam ki aag hi hai jo pani ki surat mein hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain aasman-o-zameen ki ibtidai paidaish ke waqt se aaj tak woh garam kiya ja raha hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H) farmate hain badkar shakhs ki peshani ke baal pakar kar use is garam pani mein ek ghota diya jayega, tamam gosht gal jayega aur haddiyon ko chor dega. Bas do aankhein aur haddiyon ka dhancha reh jayega, isi ko farmaya aayat (فِي الْحَمِيْمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُوْنَ) (Surah Ghafir: 72). In ke ma'ani hazir ke bhi kiye gaye hain aur aayat mein hai (تُسْقٰى مِنْ عَيْنٍ اٰنِيَةٍ) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 5), sakht garam maujood pani ki nehar se unhein pani pilaya jayega jo hargiz na pi sakenge kyunke woh be-inteha garam balkay misl-e-aag ke hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai aayat (غَيْرَ نٰظِرِيْنَ اِنٰىهُ) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 53), wahan murad tayari aur pak jana hai. Chunke badkaron ki saza aur nek karon ki jaza bhi us ka fazl-o-rahmat aur adl-o-lutf hai, apne in azabon ka qabl az waqt bayan kar dena taake shirk-o-ma'asi ke karne wale hoshiyar ho jayen yeh bhi us ki ne'amat hai, is liye farmaya phir tum ae jinn-o-ins apne Rabb ki kaun kaun si ne'amat ka inkar karoge.

Peeth ki taraf zanjeer la kar gardan aur paon ek kar ke bandh diye jayenge. Kamar tor di jaye gi aur qadam aur peshani mila di jaye gi aur jakar diya jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai qabeela Banu Kunda ka ek shakhs Mai Aisha (R.A) ke paas gaya. Parde ke peeche baitha aur Umm-ul-Momineen se sawal kiya ke kya aap ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh bhi suna hai ke kisi waqt aap (ﷺ) ko kisi shakhs ki shafa'at ka ikhtiyar na hoga? Aur jis waqt ke chehre safaid hone shuru honge yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mere sath kya kya kiya jata hai? Ya farmaya yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mujh par kya wahi bheji jati hai? Farmaya talwar ki dhaar jaisa tez hoga aur aag ke angare jaisa garam hoga. Momin to be-zarar guzar jaye ga aur munafiq latak jaye ga, jab beech mein pohanche ga us ke qadam phisal jayenge, yeh apne hath apne pairon ki taraf jhukaye ga jis tarah koi nange paon chal raha ho aur use kanta lag jaye aur us zor ka lage ke goya ke us ne us ka paon chhed diya to kis tarah be-sabri aur jaldi se woh sar aur hath jhuka kar us ki taraf jhuk parta hai, isi tarah yeh jhuke ga, udhar yeh jhuka udhar darogha-e-Jahannam ki aag mein gira de ga jis mein taqreeban pachaas pachaas saal tak woh gehra utarta jaye ga. Main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh jahannami kis qadar bojhal hoga? Aap ne farmaya misl das gabhan oontniyon ke wazan ke, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Is jaisi daleelein sehat ke qabil nahin hotin, Wallahu A'alam. In gunahgaron se kaha jaye ga ke lo jis Jahannam ka tum inkar karte thay use apni aankhon se dekh lo, yeh unhein bator-e-ruswa aur zaleel karne, sharminda aur nadim karne, un ki khiffat barhane ke liye kaha jaye ga. Phir un ki yeh halat hogi ke kabhi aag ka azab ho raha hai kabhi pani ka. Kabhi Jaheem mein jalaye jate hain aur kabhi Hameem pilaye jate hain. Jo pighle hue tanbe ki tarah mehez aag hai jo aanton ko kaat deti hai aur jagah hai aayat (Izi-l-aghlalu fi a'naqihim wa-ssalasilu yushabun) (40. Ghafir: 71), jab ke un ki gardanon mein toq honge aur paon mein beriyan hongi, woh Hameem se Jaheem mein ghaseete jayenge aur baar baar yeh jalaye jayenge.

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke farishte puchenge nahin, woh toh chehra dekhte hi pehchan lenge aur jahannami ko zanjeeron mein bandh kar ondhay ghasit kar jahannam wasil kar denge, jaise is ke baad hi farmaya ke yeh gunahgar apne chehron aur apni khas alamaton se pehchan liye jayenge, chehre siyah honge, aankhein kairi hongi, theek isi tarah mominon ke chehre bhi alag mumtaz honge. Gunahgaron ko peshaniyon aur qadmon se pakra jaye ga aur Jahannam mein daal diya jaye ga jis tarah bari lakri ko do taraf se pakar kar tanoor mein jhonk diya jata hai. Peeth ki taraf zanjeer la kar gardan aur paon ek kar ke bandh diye jayenge. Kamar tor di jaye gi aur qadam aur peshani mila di jaye gi aur jakar diya jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai qabeela Banu Kunda ka ek shakhs Mai Aisha (R.A) ke paas gaya. Parde ke peeche baitha aur Umm-ul-Momineen se sawal kiya ke kya aap ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yeh bhi suna hai ke kisi waqt aap (ﷺ) ko kisi shakhs ki shafa'at ka ikhtiyar na hoga? Umm-ul-Momineen ne jawab diya haan, ek martaba ek hi kapre mein hum dono thay, main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ) se yahi sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya haan, jab ke Pul-e-Sirat rakha jaye ga us waqt mujhe kisi ki shafa'at ka ikhtiyar na hoga yahan tak ke main jaan loon ke khud mujhe kahan le jate hain? Aur jis waqt ke chehre safaid hone shuru honge yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mere sath kya kya kiya jata hai? Ya farmaya yahan tak ke main dekh loon ke mujh par kya wahi bheji jati hai? Aur jab Jahannam par pul rakha jaye ga aur use tez aur garam kiya jaye ga, main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) is ki tezi aur garmi ki kya had hai? Farmaya talwar ki dhaar jaisa tez hoga aur aag ke angare jaisa garam hoga. Momin to be-zarar guzar jaye ga aur munafiq latak jaye ga, jab beech mein pohanche ga us ke qadam phisal jayenge, yeh apne hath apne pairon ki taraf jhukaye ga jis tarah koi nange paon chal raha ho aur use kanta lag jaye aur us zor ka lage ke goya ke us ne us ka paon chhed diya to kis tarah be-sabri aur jaldi se woh sar aur hath jhuka kar us ki taraf jhuk parta hai, isi tarah yeh jhuke ga, udhar yeh jhuka udhar darogha-e-Jahannam ki aag mein gira de ga jis mein taqreeban pachaas pachaas saal tak woh gehra utarta jaye ga. Main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh jahannami kis qadar bojhal hoga? Aap ne farmaya misl das gabhan oontniyon ke wazan ke, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is ke ba'az fiqron ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ke kalam se hona munkar hai aur is ki asnaad mein ek shakhs hai jis ka naam bhi neeche rawi ne nahin liya. Is jaisi daleelein sehat ke qabil nahin hotin, Wallahu A'alam. In gunahgaron se kaha jaye ga ke lo jis Jahannam ka tum inkar karte thay use apni aankhon se dekh lo, yeh unhein bator-e-ruswa aur zaleel karne, sharminda aur nadim karne, un ki khiffat barhane ke liye kaha jaye ga. Phir un ki yeh halat hogi ke kabhi aag ka azab ho raha hai kabhi pani ka. Kabhi Jaheem mein jalaye jate hain aur kabhi Hameem pilaye jate hain. Jo pighle hue tanbe ki tarah mehez aag hai jo aanton ko kaat deti hai aur jagah hai aayat (Izi-l-aghlalu fi a'naqihim wa-ssalasilu yushabun) (40. Ghafir: 71), jab ke un ki gardanon mein toq honge aur paon mein beriyan hongi, woh Hameem se Jaheem mein ghaseete jayenge aur baar baar yeh jalaye jayenge.

Momin to be-zarar guzar jaye ga aur munafiq latak jaye ga, jab beech mein pohanche ga us ke qadam phisal jayenge, yeh apne hath apne pairon ki taraf jhukaye ga jis tarah koi nange paon chal raha ho aur use kanta lag jaye aur us zor ka lage ke goya ke us ne us ka paon chhed diya to kis tarah be-sabri aur jaldi se woh sar aur hath jhuka kar us ki taraf jhuk parta hai, isi tarah yeh jhuke ga, udhar yeh jhuka udhar darogha-e-Jahannam ki aag mein gira de ga jis mein taqreeban pachaas pachaas saal tak woh gehra utarta jaye ga. Main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh jahannami kis qadar bojhal hoga? Aap ne farmaya misl das gabhan oontniyon ke wazan ke, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai aur is ke ba'az fiqron ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ke kalam se hona munkar hai aur is ki asnaad mein ek shakhs hai jis ka naam bhi neeche rawi ne nahin liya. Is jaisi daleelein sehat ke qabil nahin hotin, Wallahu A'alam. In gunahgaron se kaha jaye ga ke lo jis Jahannam ka tum inkar karte thay use apni aankhon se dekh lo, yeh unhein bator-e-ruswa aur zaleel karne, sharminda aur nadim karne, un ki khiffat barhane ke liye kaha jaye ga. Phir un ki yeh halat hogi ke kabhi aag ka azab ho raha hai kabhi pani ka. Kabhi Jaheem mein jalaye jate hain aur kabhi Hameem pilaye jate hain. Jo pighle hue tanbe ki tarah mehez aag hai jo aanton ko kaat deti hai aur jagah hai aayat (Izi-l-aghlalu fi a'naqihim wa-ssalasilu yushabun) (40. Ghafir: 71), jab ke un ki gardanon mein toq honge aur paon mein beriyan hongi, woh Hameem se Jaheem mein ghaseete jayenge aur baar baar yeh jalaye jayenge.

Yeh garam pani hadd-e-darja ka garam hoga, bas yun kehna theek hai ke woh bhi Jahannam ki aag hi hai jo pani ki surat mein hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain aasman-o-zameen ki ibtidai paidaish ke waqt se aaj tak woh garam kiya ja raha hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H) farmate hain badkar shakhs ki peshani ke baal pakar kar use is garam pani mein ek ghota diya jayega, tamam gosht gal jayega aur haddiyon ko chor dega. Bas do aankhein aur haddiyon ka dhancha reh jayega, isi ko farmaya aayat (فِي الْحَمِيْمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُوْنَ) (Surah Ghafir: 72). In ke ma'ani hazir ke bhi kiye gaye hain aur aayat mein hai (تُسْقٰى مِنْ عَيْنٍ اٰنِيَةٍ) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 5), sakht garam maujood pani ki nehar se unhein pani pilaya jayega jo hargiz na pi sakenge kyunke woh be-inteha garam balkay misl-e-aag ke hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai aayat (غَيْرَ نٰظِرِيْنَ اِنٰىهُ) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 53), wahan murad tayari aur pak jana hai. Chunke badkaron ki saza aur nek karon ki jaza bhi us ka fazl-o-rahmat aur adl-o-lutf hai, apne in azabon ka qabl az waqt bayan kar dena taake shirk-o-ma'asi ke karne wale hoshiyar ho jayen yeh bhi us ki ne'amat hai, is liye farmaya phir tum ae jinn-o-ins apne Rabb ki kaun kaun si ne'amat ka inkar karoge.

Aasman phat jaye ga waqt-e-ehtisab hoga. Aasman ka phat jana aur aayaton mein bhi bayan hua hai. Irshad hai aayat (WA-INSHAQQATIS-SAMA'U FAHIYA YAWM'IDHIN WAHIYAH) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 16). Ek aur jagah hai aayat (WA YAWMA TASH AQQQUS-SAMA'U BIL-GHAMAMI WA NUNZILAL-MALA'IKATU TANZILA) (Surah Al-Furqan: 25), aur farman hai aayat (IDHAS-SAMA'UN SHAQQAT) (Surah Al-Inshiqaq: 1), waghera. Jis tarah chandi waghera pighlai jati hai yahi halat aasman ki ho jaye gi, rang par rang badle ga kyunke Qayamat ki holnaki, uski shiddat-o-dehshat hai hi aisi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai log Qayamat ke din uthaye jayenge aur aasman un par halki barish ki tarah barasta hoga. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain surkh chamre ki tarah ho jaye ga. Ek riwayat mein gulabi rang, ghore ke rang jaisa aasman ka rang ho jaye ga. Abu Saleh R.H farmate hain pehle gulabi rang hoga phir surkh ho jaye ga. Gulabi rang ghore ka rang mausam-e-bahar mein toh zardi mail nazar aata hai aur jare mein badal kar surkh jachta hai, joon joon sardi barhti hai uska rang mutaghayyar hota jata hai. Isi tarah aasman bhi rang par rang badle ga, pighle hue tanbe ki tarah ho jaye ga. Jaise roghan-e-gulab ka rang hota hai us rang ka aasman ho jaye ga. Aaj woh sabz rang hai lekin us din uska rang surkhi liye hue hoga, zaitoon ki talchhat jaisa ho jaye ga. Jahannam ki aag tapish use pighla kar tel jaisa kar degi. Us din kisi mujrim se uska jurm na pucha jaye ga jaise ek aur aayat mein hai (HADHA YAWMU LA YANTIQUN) (Surah Al-Mursalat: 35), yeh woh din hai ke baat na karenge na unhein ijazat di jaye gi ke woh uzr-o-ma'zarat karein. Haan aur aayaton mein unka bolna, uzr karna, un se hisab liya jana waghera bhi bayan hua hai. Farman hai aayat (FAWARABBIKA LANAS'ALANNAHUM AJMA'IN) (Surah Al-Hijr: 92), tere Rab ki qasam hum sab se sawal karenge aur un ke tamam kamon ki pursish karenge. Toh matlab yeh hai ke ek mauqa par yeh hai pursish hui, hisab kitab hua, uzr-o-ma'zarat khatam kar di gayi, ab munh par mohar lag gayi, hath paon aur a'za-e-jism ne gawahi di, phir puch guch ki zaroorat na rahi, uzr-o-ma'zarat tor di gayi. Aur yeh tatbiq bhi hai ke kisi se na pucha jaye ga ke falan amal kiya? Ya nahin kiya? Kyunke Allah ko toh khub maloom hai, us se jo sawal hoga woh yeh ke aisa kyun kiya? Teesra qaul yeh hai ke farishte puchenge nahin, woh toh chehra dekhte hi pehchan lenge aur jahannami ko zanjeeron mein bandh kar ondhay ghasit kar jahannam wasil kar denge, jaise is ke baad hi farmaya ke yeh gunahgar apne chehron aur apni khas alamaton se pehchan liye jayenge, chehre siyah honge, aankhein kairi hongi, theek isi tarah mominon ke chehre bhi alag mumtaz honge. Un ke a'za-e-wuzu chand ki tarah chamak rahe honge.

Fikr-e-Aakhirat aur Insaan. Ibn-e-Shauzab aur Ata Khurasani farmate hain aayat (Wa liman khaafa maqaama Rabbihi Jannataan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ke baare mein naazil hui hai, Hazrat Atiya bin Qais farmate hain yeh aayat us shakhs ke baare mein naazil hui hai jis ne kaha tha mujhe aag mein jala dena taake main Allah Ta'ala ko dhoondne par na miloon, yeh kalma kehne ke baad ek raat ek din tauba ki, Allah Ta'ala ne qubool farma li aur usey jannat mein le gaya. Lekin sahih baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat aam hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Matlab yeh hai ke jo shakhs Qayamat ke din apne Rab ke saamne khada hone ka darr apne dilon mein rakhta hai aur apne aap ko nafs ki khwahishon se bachata hai aur sarkashi nahin karta, zindagani-e-duniya ke peeche pad kar aakhirat se ghaflat nahin karta, balkay aakhirat ki fikr zyada karta hai aur usey behtar aur paayedaar samajhta hai, faraiz baja lata hai, muharramat se rukta hai, Qayamat ke din usey ek chhod do do jannatein milengi. Sahih Bukhari mein hai, "Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ke do jannatein chandi ki hongi aur un ka tamam saamaan bhi chandi ka hi hoga aur do jannatein sone ki hongi, un ke bartan aur jo kuch un mein hai sab sone ka hoga, in jannatiyon mein aur deedar-e-Baari mein koi cheez haail na hogi siwaye us kibriyaai ke parde ke jo Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke chehre par hai, yeh jannat-e-Adan mein honge." Yeh hadith Sahah ki aur kitabon mein bhi hai bajuz Abu Dawood ke, raawi-e-hadith Hazrat Hammad farmate hain mere khayal mein toh yeh hadith marfoo hai. Tafsir hai Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan aayat (Wa liman khaafa maqaama Rabbihi Jannataan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) aur aayat (Wa min doonihima Jannataan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 62) ki. Sone ki do jannatein muqarrabeen ke liye aur chandi ki do jannatein yameen ke liye. Ek ka naam Tasneem hai dusri ka Salsabil hai, yeh dono nahrein puri rawani ke sath beh rahi hain. Ek suthre pani ki, dusri lazzat wale be-nashe ke sharab ki. Tumhein yeh zeb nahin deta ke tum apne Parwardigar ki kisi ne'mat ka inkaar karo.

(Afnan) shakhon aur daliyon ko kehte hain, yeh apni kasrat se ek dusri se mili juli hui hongi aur saya-dar hongi jin ka saya diwaron par bhi charha hua hoga, Ikrama yahi ma'ani bayan karte hain aur Arabi ke sher ko is par daleel mein warid karte hain, yeh shakhein seedhi aur pheli hui rang-barang ki hongi. Yeh tamam aqwal sahih hain aur in mein koi munafiyat nahin, yeh tamam ausaf in shakhon mein honge. Hazrat Asma R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sidratul Muntaha ka zikr karte hue farmaya: Is ki shakhon ka saya is qadar daraz hai ke sawar sau saal tak is mein chala jaye. Phir in mein nahrein beh rahi hain taake in darakhton aur shakhon ko sairab karti rahein aur bakasrat aur umda phal layein. Ab to tumhein apne Rab ki nematon ki qadr karni chahiye. Ek ka naam Tasneem hai dusri ka Salsabil hai, yeh dono nahrein puri rawani ke sath beh rahi hain. Ek suthre pani ki, dusri lazzat wale be-nashe ke sharab ki. In mein har qisam ke phalon ke jode bhi maujood hain aur phal bhi woh jin se tum surat-shanas to ho lekin lazzat-shanas nahin ho, kyunke wahan ki nematein kisi aankh ne dekhi hain, na kisi kaan ne suni hain, na kisi dimagh mein aa sakti hain, tumhein Rab ki nematon ki nashukri se ruk jana chahiye. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain duniya mein jitne bhi kadwe meethe phal hain woh sab Jannat mein honge, yahan tak ke Hanzal yani Indrayan bhi. Jannat yafta log jannati log be-fikri se takiye lagaye hue honge khwah lete hue hon khwah ba-aaram baithe hue takiye se lage hue hon. Un ke bichhaune bhi itne badhiya honge ke un ke andar ka astar bhi dabeez aur khalis zareen resham ka hoga phir upar ka abra kuch aisa hoga use tum aap soch lo. Malik bin Dinar aur Sufyan Sauri R.H farmate hain astar ka yeh haal hai aur abra to mehez noorani hoga jo sarasar izhar-e-rehmat-o-noor hoga. Phir us par behtareen gulkariyan hain jinhein Allah ke siwa koi nahin janta. In jannaton ke phal jannatiyon se bilkul qareeb hain. Jab chahein jis haal mein chahein wahan se le lein, lete hon to baitha hone ki aur baithe hon to khada hone ki zaroorat nahin, khud-ba-khud shakhein jhoom jhoom kar jhukti rehti hain. Jaise farmaya ayat (QUTUFUHA DANIYAH 23) (69. Al-Haqqah: 23) aur farmaya ayat (WA DANIYATAN ALAIHIM ZILALUHA WA ZULLILAT QUTUFUHA TAZLILA 14) (76. Al-Insan: 14), yani be-had qareeb meway hain, lene wale ko koi takleef ya takalluf ki zaroorat nahin, khud shakhein jhuk jhuk kar unhein meway de rahi hain. Pas tum apne Rab ki nematon ke inkar se baaz raho. Chunki farosh ka bayan hua tha to sath hi farmaya ke un farosh par un ke sath un ki biwiyan hongi, jo afifa, pak-daman, sharmili nigahon wali hongi, apne khawandon ke siwa kisi par nazrein na dalein gi aur un ke khawand bhi un par sau jaan se mail honge. Yeh bhi jannat ki kisi cheez ko apne in momin khawandon se behtar na payein gi. Yeh bhi warid hua hai ke yeh hoorein apne khawandon se kahein gi Allah ki qasam sari jannat mein mere liye tum se behtar koi cheez nahin, Allah khoob janta hai ke mere dil mein jannat ki kisi cheez ki khwahish-o-mohabbat itni nahin jitni aap ki hai, Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne aap ko mere hisse mein kar diya aur mujhe aap ki khidmat ka sharaf bakhsha. Yeh hoorein kunwari achooti naujawan hongi, in jannatiyon se pehle un ke pak jism ko kisi ins-o-jinn ka hath bhi na laga. Yeh ayat bhi momin jinnon ke jannat mein jaane ki daleel hai. Pas tum apne Rab ki nematon ke inkar se baaz raho. Chunki farosh ka bayan hua tha to sath hi farmaya ke un farosh par un ke sath un ki biwiyan hongi, jo afifa, pak-daman, sharmili nigahon wali hongi, apne khawandon ke siwa kisi par nazrein na dalein gi aur un ke khawand bhi un par sau jaan se mail honge. Yeh bhi warid hua hai ke yeh hoorein apne khawandon se kahein gi Allah ki qasam sari jannat mein mere liye tum se behtar koi cheez nahin, Allah khoob janta hai ke mere dil mein jannat ki kisi cheez ki khwahish-o-mohabbat itni nahin jitni aap ki hai, Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne aap ko mere hisse mein kar diya aur mujhe aap ki khidmat ka sharaf bakhsha. Yeh hoorein kunwari achooti naujawan hongi, in jannatiyon se pehle un ke pak jism ko kisi ins-o-jinn ka hath bhi na laga. Yeh ayat bhi momin jinnon ke jannat mein jaane ki daleel hai. Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main jis par apni tauheed ka inaam duniya mein karoon us ka badla aakhirat mein jannat hai aur chunke yeh bhi ek azeem-ush-shan nemat hai jo darasal kisi amal ke badle nahin balkay sirf usi ka ehsaan aur fazl-o-karam hai is liye is ke baad hi farmaya ab tum meri kis kis nemat se laparwahi barto ge? Rab ke maqam se darne wale ki basharat ke mutaliq Tirmidhi Sharif ki yeh hadith bhi khayal mein rahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo dare ga woh raat ke waqt hi kooch kare ga aur jo andheri raat mein chal pada woh manzil-e-maqsood tak pahunch jaye ga khabardar ho jao Allah ka sauda bahut giraan hai yaad rakho woh sauda jannat hai. Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ko ghareeb batate hain. Hazrat Abu Darda (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne mimbar par wa'az bayan farmate hue suna kaha aap ne aayat (وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهٖ جَنَّتٰنِ 46ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) padhi to main ne kaha agarche zina kiya ho agarche chori ki ho? Baqi hadith oopar guzar chuki.

Jannat yafta log jannati log be-fikri se takiye lagaye hue honge khwah lete hue hon khwah ba-aaram baithe hue takiye se lage hue hon. Un ke bichhaune bhi itne badhiya honge ke un ke andar ka astar bhi dabeez aur khalis zareen resham ka hoga phir upar ka abra kuch aisa hoga use tum aap soch lo. Malik bin Dinar aur Sufyan Sauri R.H farmate hain astar ka yeh haal hai aur abra to mehez noorani hoga jo sarasar izhar-e-rehmat-o-noor hoga. Phir us par behtareen gulkariyan hain jinhein Allah ke siwa koi nahin janta. In jannaton ke phal jannatiyon se bilkul qareeb hain. Jab chahein jis haal mein chahein wahan se le lein, lete hon to baitha hone ki aur baithe hon to khada hone ki zaroorat nahin, khud-ba-khud shakhein jhoom jhoom kar jhukti rehti hain. Jaise farmaya ayat (QUTUFUHA DANIYAH 23) (69. Al-Haqqah: 23) aur farmaya ayat (WA DANIYATAN ALAIHIM ZILALUHA WA ZULLILAT QUTUFUHA TAZLILA 14) (76. Al-Insan: 14), yani be-had qareeb meway hain, lene wale ko koi takleef ya takalluf ki zaroorat nahin, khud shakhein jhuk jhuk kar unhein meway de rahi hain. Pas tum apne Rab ki nematon ke inkar se baaz raho. Chunki farosh ka bayan hua tha to sath hi farmaya ke un farosh par un ke sath un ki biwiyan hongi, jo afifa, pak-daman, sharmili nigahon wali hongi, apne khawandon ke siwa kisi par nazrein na dalein gi aur un ke khawand bhi un par sau jaan se mail honge. Yeh bhi jannat ki kisi cheez ko apne in momin khawandon se behtar na payein gi. Yeh bhi warid hua hai ke yeh hoorein apne khawandon se kahein gi Allah ki qasam sari jannat mein mere liye tum se behtar koi cheez nahin, Allah khoob janta hai ke mere dil mein jannat ki kisi cheez ki khwahish-o-mohabbat itni nahin jitni aap ki hai, Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne aap ko mere hisse mein kar diya aur mujhe aap ki khidmat ka sharaf bakhsha. Yeh hoorein kunwari achooti naujawan hongi, in jannatiyon se pehle un ke pak jism ko kisi ins-o-jinn ka hath bhi na laga. Yeh ayat bhi momin jinnon ke jannat mein jaane ki daleel hai. Hazrat Zamra bin Habib R.H se sawal hota hai ke kya momin jinn bhi jannat mein jayenge? Aap ne farmaya haan aur jiniya aurton se un ke nikah honge jaise insan ke insan aurton se. Phir yahi ayatein tilawat keen. Phir in hooron ki tareef bayan ho rahi hai ke woh apni safai, khoobi aur husn mein aisi hain jaise yaqoot-o-marjan, yaqoot se safai mein tashbeeh di aur marjan se bayaz mein, pas marjan se murad yahan lulu hai. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ahl-e-jannat ki biwiyon mein se har ek aisi hai ke un ki pindli ki safedi sattar sattar hullon ke pehanne ke baad bhi nazar aati hai yahan tak ke andar ka goda bhi. Aap ne ayat (KA-ANNAHUNNAL YAQUTU WAL MARJAN 58) (55. Ar-Rahman: 58) tilawat farmayi.

(Ar-Rahman: 58) padhi aur farmaya dekho yaqoot ek patthar hai lekin qudrat ne is ki safai aur jot aisi rakhi hai ke is ke beech mein dhaga piro do to bahar se nazar aata hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi mein bhi mauqoofan Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se marwi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi is ko zyada sahih batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai paighambar-e-madani Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) farmate hain ke har ahl-e-jannat ki do biwiyan is sifat ki hongi ke sattar sattar hullay pehan lene ke baad bhi un ki pindliyon ki jhalak namoodar rahegi balkay andar ka gooda bhi ba-wajah-e-safai ke dikhai dega. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke ya to fakhr ke taur par ya muzakara ke taur par yeh behas chhid gayi ke jannat mein auratein zyada hongi ya mard? To Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya kya Abul Qasim (ﷺ) ne yeh nahin farmaya? Ke pehli jamaat jo jannat mein jayegi woh chand jaisi suraton wali hogi un ke peeche jo jamaat jayegi woh aasman ke behtareen chamkeele taron jaise chehron wali hogi. In mein se har shakhs ki do biwiyan aisi hongi jin ki pindli ka gooda gosht ke peeche se nazar aayega aur jannat mein koi baghair biwi ke na hoga. Is hadith ki asal Bukhari mein bhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Allah ki rah ki subh aur sham sari duniya se aur jo is mein hai sab se behtar hai. Jannat mein jo jagah milegi is mein ek kamaan ya ek koday ke barabar ki jagah sari duniya aur is ki sari cheezon se afzal hai agar jannat ki auraton mein se ek aurat duniya mein jhank le to zameen-o-aasman ko jagmaga de aur khushbu se tamam aalam mehak uthay. In ki halki si chhoti dopattiya bhi duniya aur duniya ki har cheez se garan hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith bhi hai. Phir irshad hai ke jis ne duniya mein neki ki is ka badla aakhirat mein sulook-o-ehsan ke siwa aur kuch nahin jaise irshad hai (Lilladhina ahsanul husna wa ziyadah 10. Yunus: 26) neki karne wale ke liye neki hai aur ziyadati yani jannat aur deedar-e-bari.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat tilawat kar ke apne as-haab se poocha jaante ho tumhare Rab ne kya kaha? Unhon ne kaha Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hi ilm hai. Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main jis par apni tauheed ka inaam duniya mein karoon us ka badla aakhirat mein jannat hai aur chunke yeh bhi ek azeem-ush-shan nemat hai jo darasal kisi amal ke badle nahin balkay sirf usi ka ehsaan aur fazl-o-karam hai is liye is ke baad hi farmaya ab tum meri kis kis nemat se laparwahi barto ge? Rab ke maqam se darne wale ki basharat ke mutaliq Tirmidhi Sharif ki yeh hadith bhi khayal mein rahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo dare ga woh raat ke waqt hi kooch kare ga aur jo andheri raat mein chal pada woh manzil-e-maqsood tak pahunch jaye ga khabardar ho jao Allah ka sauda bahut giraan hai yaad rakho woh sauda jannat hai. Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ko ghareeb batate hain. Hazrat Abu Darda (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne mimbar par wa'az bayan farmate hue suna kaha aap ne aayat (وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهٖ جَنَّتٰنِ 46ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) padhi to main ne kaha agarche zina kiya ho agarche chori ki ho? Baqi hadith oopar guzar chuki.

Ashab-e-Yameen aur Muqarrabeen, yeh dono jannatein hain jin ka zikr in aayaton mein hai. In jannaton se kam martaba hain jin ka zikr pehle guzra aur woh hadith bhi bayan ho chuki jis mein hai do jannatein sone ki aur do chandi ki. Pehli do toh Muqarrabeen-e-Khas ki jagah hain aur yeh dusri do Ashab-e-Yameen ki. Al-gharaz darje aur fazeelat mein yeh do un do se kam hain jis ki daleelein bahut si hain. Ek yeh ke un ka zikr aur saf un se pehle bayan hui aur yeh taqdeem-e-bayan bhi daleel hai un ki fazeelat ki. Phir yahan aayat (وَمِنْ دُوْنِهِمَا جَنَّتٰنِ 62ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 62) farmana saaf zahir karta hai ke yeh un se kam martaba hain. Wahan un ki tareef mein aayat (ذَوَاتَآ اَفْنَانٍ 48ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 48) yani bakasrat mukhtalif mazay ke mewon wali shakh-dar. Yahan farmaya aayat (مُدْهَاۗمَّتٰنِ 64ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 64) yani pani ki puri tari se siyah. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain sabz, Muhammad bin Ka'ab R.H farmate hain sabzi se pur, Qatada R.H farmate hain is qadar phal pakay huay tayyar hain ke woh sari jannat sarsabz maloom ho rahi hai. Al-gharaz wahan shakhon ki phailawat bayan hui yahan darakhton ki kasrat bayan farmayi gayi toh zahir hai ke is mein aur us mein bhi bahut farq hai. Un ki nehron ki babat lafz aayat (تجریان) hai aur yahan lafz aayat (فِيْهِمَا عَيْنٰنِ نَضَّاخَتٰنِ 66ۚ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 66) hai yani ubalne wali aur yeh zahir hai ke nazkh se jari yani ubalne se behna bahut bartari wala hai. Hazrat Zahhak R.H farmate hain yani pur hain pani rukta nahin. Aur lijiye wahan farmaya tha ke har qisam ke mewon ke joray hain aur yahan farmaya is mein meway aur khajoorein aur anaar hain toh zahir hai ke pehle ke alfaaz umoomiyat ke liye huay hain woh qisam ke aitbar se aur kamiyat ke aitbar se bhi is se afzaliyat rakhte hain kyunke yahan lafz fakiha go nakra hai lekin siyaq mein isbat ke hai is liye aam na hoga isi liye bator tafseer ke baad mein nakhl-o-rumman keh diya. Jaise atf-e-khas aam par hota hai. Imam Bukhari R.H waghera ki tehqeeq bhi yahi hai, khajoor aur anaar ko khassatan is liye zikr kiya ke aur mewon par unhein sharaf hai. Musnad Abd bin Hameed R.H mein hai Yahudiyon ne aakar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke kya jannat mein meway hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya haan hain. Unhon ne pucha kya jannati duniya ki tarah wahan bhi khayenge piyenge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan balkay bahut kuch zyada aur bahut kuch zyada. Unhon ne kaha phir wahan fazla bhi niklay ga? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin nahin balkay paseena aakar sab hazam ho jaye ga. Ibn Abi Hatim R.H ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai jannati khajoor ke darakhton ke reshay ka jannatiyon ka libas banayenge. Yeh surkh rang sone ke honge is ke tanay sabz zumurrad mein honge is ke phal shehad se zyada meethe aur makkhan se zyada narm honge guthli bilkul na hogi. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke main ne jannat ke anaar dekhe itne baray thay jaise oont ma'a hawdaj.

Khairat ke ma'ani ba-kasrat aur bahut haseen nihayat nek khulq aur behtar khulq. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh ma'ani marwi hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke hoor-e-ain jo gana gayengi un mein yeh bhi hoga hum khush-khulq khubsurat hain jo buzurg khawandon ke liye paida ki gayi hain, yeh poori hadith Surah Waqi'ah ki tafsir mein abhi aayegi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yeh lafz tashdeed se bhi padha gaya hai. Phir sawal hota hai ke ab tum apne Rab ki kis kis ne'amat ki takzeeb karte ho? Hoorein hain jo khaimon mein rehti sehti hain. Yahan bhi wahi farq mulahiza ho ke wahan toh farmaya tha ke khud woh hoorein apni nigah neechi rakhti hain aur yahan farmaya un ki nigahain neechi ki gayi hain, pas apne aap ek kaam karna aur dusre se karaya jana in dono mein kis qadar farq hai go parda dono suraton mein hasil hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain har musalman ke liye khaira yani nek aur behtareen noorani hoor aur har khaira ke liye khaima hai aur khaime ke chaar darwaze hain jin mein se har roz tohfa-e-karamat, hadiya aur inaam aata rehta hai. Na wahan koi fasad hai na sakhti na gandagi na badbu. Hooron ki sohbat hai jo achootay saaf safed chamkeelay motiyon jaisi hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jannat mein ek khaima hai dur-e-mujawwaf, jis ka arz saath meel ka hai us ke har har konay mein jannati ki biwiyan hain jo dusre konay waliyon ko nazar nahin aatin, momin un sab ke paas aata jata rahega. Dusri riwayat mein chaudai ka tees meel hona marwi hai, yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain khaima ek hi lu'lu ka hai jis mein sattar darwaze moti ke hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jannat mein ek khaima hoga jo ek moti ka bana hua hoga chaar farsakh chauda jis ke chaar hazaar darwaze honge aur chaukhatain sab ki sone ki hongi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai adna darjay ke jannati ke assi hazaar khadim honge aur behtar biwiyan hongi aur lu'lu zabarjad ka mahal hoga jo Jabiya se San'a tak pahunche. Phir farmata hai in bemisal haseenon ke panday achootay hain kisi jinn-o-ins ka guzar un ke paas se nahin hua.

Pehle bhi is qisam ki aayat ma'a tafsir guzar chuki hai. Haan, pehli jannaton ki hooron ke ausaf mein itna jumla wahan tha ke woh yaqoot-o-marjan jaisi hain, yahan un ke liye yeh nahin farmaya gaya. Phir sawal hua ke tumhein Rabb ki kis kis ne'amat ka inkar hai? Ya'ni kisi ne'amat ka inkar na karna chahiye. Yeh jannati sabz rang aala qeemti farshon, ghalichon aur takiyon par tek lagaye baithe hue honge. Takht honge aur takhton par pakeeza aala farsh honge aur behtareen munaqqash takiye lage hue honge. Yeh takht, yeh farsh, yeh takiye jannat ke baghichon aur un ki kyariyon par honge aur yahi un ke farsh honge. Koi surkh rang hoga, koi zard rang aur koi sabz rang. Jannatiyon ke kapde bhi aise hi aala aur bala honge, duniya mein koi aisi cheez nahin jis se unhein tashbeeh di ja sake. Yeh bistare makhmali honge jo bahut narm aur bilkul khalis honge, kayi kayi rang ke mile jule naqsh un mein bane hue honge. Abu Ubaidah farmate hain 'Abqarah' ek jagah ka naam hai jahan munaqqash behtareen kapde bune jate the. Khalil bin Ahmed farmate hain har nafees aur aala cheez ko Arab 'Abqari' kehte hain. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki nisbat farmaya: "Main ne kisi abqari ko nahin dekha jo Umar ki tarah pani ke bade bade dol khenchta ho." Yahan yeh bhi khayal farmaiye ke pehli do jannaton ke farsh-o-farosh aur wahan ke takiyon ki jo sifat bayan ki gayi hai, woh in se aala hai. Wahan bayan farmaya gaya tha ke un ke astar ya'ni andar ka kapda khalis dabeez resham hoga, phir upar ke kapde ka bayan nahin hua tha, is liye ke jis ka astar itna aala hai us ke abray ya'ni upar ke kapde ka to kehna hi kya hai? Phir agli do jannaton ke ausaf mein ehsan ko bayan farmaya jo aala martaba aur ghayat hai, jaise ke Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) wali hadith mein hai ke unhon ne Islam ke bare mein sawal kiya, phir imaan ke bare, phir ehsan ke bare mein. Pas yeh kayi kayi wajooh hain jin se saaf sabit hota hai ke pehle ki do jannaton ko in do jannaton par behtareen fazeelat hasil hai. Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Wahhab se hamara sawal hai ke woh hamein bhi un jannatiyon mein se kare jo un do jannaton mein honge jin ke ausaf pehle bayan hue hain. Aameen. Wohi mustahiq-e-ehtram-o-ikram hai. Phir farmata hai tere Rabb Zul-Jalal-wal-Ikram ka naam babarakat hai. Woh Jalal wala hai ya'ni is laiq hai ke us ka jalal mana jaye aur us ki buzurgi ka paas kar ke us ki nafarmani na ki jaye balkay kamil itaat guzari ki jaye aur woh is qabil hai ke us ka ikram kiya jaye ya'ni us ki ibadat ki jaye, us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat na ki jaye, us ka shukr kiya jaye, nashukri na ki jaye, us ka zikr kiya jaye aur use bhulaya na jaye. Woh azmat aur kibriyai wala hai.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka ijlal karo us ki azmat ko mano woh tumhein bakhsh de ga (Ahmad). Ek aur hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ki azmat manne mein yeh bhi dakhil hai ke boorhay musalman ki aur badshah ki aur aamil-e-Quran jo Quran mein kami ziyadati na karta ho yani na is mein ghulu karta ho na kami karta ho izzat ki jaye. Abu Ya'la mein hai (Ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram) ke sath chimat jao. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi is ki sanad ko ghair mehfooz aur ghareeb batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein dusri sanad ke sath yeh hadith marwi hai is mein 'Ya' ka lafz nahin. Johari farmate hain ke jab koi kisi ko chimat jaye use tham lo to Arab kehte hain (Alazza) yani lafz is hadith mein aaya hai to matlab yeh hai ke ilhah-o-khuloos, aajizi aur maskeeni ke sath hameshangi aur luzoom se daman-e-Ilahiya mein latak jao. Sahih Muslim aur Sunan-e-Arba'a mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz se salam pherne ke baad sirf itni hi der baithte thay ke yeh kalmaat keh lein, dua: (Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salamu tabarakta ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram). Alhamdulillah, Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Ar-Rahman ki tafsir khatam hui. Allah ka shukr hai.

Pehle bhi is qisam ki aayat ma'a tafsir guzar chuki hai. Haan, pehli jannaton ki hooron ke ausaf mein itna jumla wahan tha ke woh yaqoot-o-marjan jaisi hain, yahan un ke liye yeh nahin farmaya gaya. Jannatiyon ke kapde bhi aise hi aala aur bala honge, duniya mein koi aisi cheez nahin jis se unhein tashbeeh di ja sake. Yeh bistare makhmali honge jo bahut narm aur bilkul khalis honge, kayi kayi rang ke mile jule naqsh un mein bane hue honge. Abu Ubaidah farmate hain 'Abqarah' ek jagah ka naam hai jahan munaqqash behtareen kapde bune jate the. Khalil bin Ahmed farmate hain har nafees aur aala cheez ko Arab 'Abqari' kehte hain. Woh azmat aur kibriyai wala hai.

Jannatiyon ke kapde bhi aise hi aala aur bala honge, duniya mein koi aisi cheez nahin jis se unhein tashbeeh di ja sake. Yeh bistare makhmali honge jo bahut narm aur bilkul khalis honge, kayi kayi rang ke mile jule naqsh un mein bane hue honge. Woh azmat aur kibriyai wala hai.

Dusri riwayat mein chaudai ka tees meel hona marwi hai, yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain khaima ek hi lu'lu ka hai jis mein sattar darwaze moti ke hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jannat mein ek khaima hoga jo ek moti ka bana hua hoga chaar farsakh chauda jis ke chaar hazaar darwaze honge aur chaukhatain sab ki sone ki hongi. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai adna darjay ke jannati ke assi hazaar khadim honge aur behtar biwiyan hongi aur lu'lu zabarjad ka mahal hoga jo Jabiya se San'a tak pahunche. Phir farmata hai in bemisal haseenon ke panday achootay hain kisi jinn-o-ins ka guzar un ke paas se nahin hua.

Pehle bhi is qisam ki aayat ma'a tafsir guzar chuki hai. Haan, pehli jannaton ki hooron ke ausaf mein itna jumla wahan tha ke woh yaqoot-o-marjan jaisi hain, yahan un ke liye yeh nahin farmaya gaya. Phir sawal hua ke tumhein Rabb ki kis kis ne'amat ka inkar hai? Ya'ni kisi ne'amat ka inkar na karna chahiye. Yeh jannati sabz rang aala qeemti farshon, ghalichon aur takiyon par tek lagaye baithe hue honge. Takht honge aur takhton par pakeeza aala farsh honge aur behtareen munaqqash takiye lage hue honge. Yeh takht, yeh farsh, yeh takiye jannat ke baghichon aur un ki kyariyon par honge aur yahi un ke farsh honge. Koi surkh rang hoga, koi zard rang aur koi sabz rang. Jannatiyon ke kapde bhi aise hi aala aur bala honge, duniya mein koi aisi cheez nahin jis se unhein tashbeeh di ja sake. Yeh bistare makhmali honge jo bahut narm aur bilkul khalis honge, kayi kayi rang ke mile jule naqsh un mein bane hue honge. Abu Ubaidah farmate hain 'Abqarah' ek jagah ka naam hai jahan munaqqash behtareen kapde bune jate the. Khalil bin Ahmed farmate hain har nafees aur aala cheez ko Arab 'Abqari' kehte hain. Chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki nisbat farmaya: "Main ne kisi abqari ko nahin dekha jo Umar ki tarah pani ke bade bade dol khenchta ho." Wahan bayan farmaya gaya tha ke un ke astar ya'ni andar ka kapda khalis dabeez resham hoga, phir upar ke kapde ka bayan nahin hua tha, is liye ke jis ka astar itna aala hai us ke abray ya'ni upar ke kapde ka to kehna hi kya hai? Phir agli do jannaton ke ausaf mein ehsan ko bayan farmaya jo aala martaba aur ghayat hai, jaise ke Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) wali hadith mein hai ke unhon ne Islam ke bare mein sawal kiya, phir imaan ke bare, phir ehsan ke bare mein. Pas yeh kayi kayi wajooh hain jin se saaf sabit hota hai ke pehle ki do jannaton ko in do jannaton par behtareen fazeelat hasil hai. Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Wahhab se hamara sawal hai ke woh hamein bhi un jannatiyon mein se kare jo un do jannaton mein honge jin ke ausaf pehle bayan hue hain. Aameen. Wohi mustahiq-e-ehtram-o-ikram hai. Phir farmata hai tere Rabb Zul-Jalal-wal-Ikram ka naam babarakat hai. Woh Jalal wala hai ya'ni is laiq hai ke us ka jalal mana jaye aur us ki buzurgi ka paas kar ke us ki nafarmani na ki jaye balkay kamil itaat guzari ki jaye aur woh is qabil hai ke us ka ikram kiya jaye ya'ni us ki ibadat ki jaye, us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat na ki jaye, us ka shukr kiya jaye, nashukri na ki jaye, us ka zikr kiya jaye aur use bhulaya na jaye. Woh azmat aur kibriyai wala hai.

Yeh bistare makhmali honge jo bahut narm aur bilkul khalis honge, kayi kayi rang ke mile jule naqsh un mein bane hue honge. Woh Jalal wala hai ya'ni is laiq hai ke us ka jalal mana jaye aur us ki buzurgi ka paas kar ke us ki nafarmani na ki jaye balkay kamil itaat guzari ki jaye aur woh is qabil hai ke us ka ikram kiya jaye ya'ni us ki ibadat ki jaye, us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat na ki jaye, us ka shukr kiya jaye, nashukri na ki jaye, us ka zikr kiya jaye aur use bhulaya na jaye.
